class.name: InputActionMap
class.brief_description: An independently editable set of actions and bindings.
class.description: Save an Input Action Map for each group of controls, such as on-foot or vehicle controls, then assign the maps to an [InputLayout]. The map named [code]Gameplay[/code] is active at boot. Enable other maps through [method Controls.set_map_enabled].

method.name: add_action
method.description: Appends a mapping for the action definition and returns the new mapping so bindings can be added. Call [method validate] to check the draft.

method.name: create
method.description: Returns an empty map draft with the given activation ID.

method.name: validate
method.description: Returns [constant OK] if the map and its mappings are valid. Duplicate action or binding IDs return [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS]. Invalid values return [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER]. [method InputLayout.validate] checks ID uniqueness across maps.

members.member: Optional readable title for tools. A blank title uses the map ID.
Case-sensitive activation ID passed to [method Controls.set_map_enabled]. Must be nonempty and unique within the layout.
Action definitions and their physical slots, in authoring order.
